adjudication.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, `contents << "\n<hr>..."` mutates the passed-in String in place before computing `content_sha1` (`Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(contents)`). This creates an API-side effect: if a caller reuses the same String instance across calls, the footer will be appended repeatedly, changing the SHA1 and potentially triggering unnecessary revisions; and if a frozen String is passed, `<<` would raise. The diff does not show any current caller reusing a single String instance (PollFeed and import_remote appear to pass freshly-created strings), so the “identical content keeps being revised” claim isn’t directly verifiable from the diff, but the in-place mutation concern itself is real and diff-grounded.
